auth_details: API key via api-key query parameter only; self-serve signup at developer.nytimes.com
free_tier_limits: 500 req/day and 5 req/min per API; free access is non-commercial only—commercial use needs NYT licensing (nytlicensing.com)
rate_limits: 500 requests per day and 5 requests per minute per API; sleep 12s between calls recommended; higher limits via code@nytimes.com
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor right—docs say query-string api-key only (https://developer.nytimes.com/faq §5; Key location:query on https://developer.nytimes.com/docs/most-popular-product/1/routes/viewed/%7Bperiod%7D.json/get); live gateway resolves request.queryparam.api-key; no official X-Api-Key. rate_limits: auditor right—FAQ §11 publishes 500/day + 5/min (https://developer.nytimes.com/faq). free_tier_limits: auditor right—same quotas plus non-commercial-only (FAQ §9–11; https://developer.nytimes.com/terms).
